notes: Sketch is signed 'Er. Muntasir Alam' (written above the porch).
assumptions: No compass or north arrow is drawn anywhere on the sketch. north_deg is left at the default 90 (north up, paper orientation kept as drawn).

The only wall-thickness callout on the sketch is '10" Wall' (leader pointing at the west exterior wall) plus 'COLUMN 10"X10"'. No separate thickness is given for the internal partitions, so 10" is used throughout. This is corroborated by arithmetic: the left column of rooms (BEDROOM 12' + KITCHEN 8' + stair bay + GUEST ROOM 11' clear) closes on exactly 40'-0" only with 10" partitions.
The 28' and 40' overall figures are taken as centre-line dimensions, as instructed. The building therefore fills the 28 x 40 plot exactly and the exterior wall centre-lines sit on the plot boundary.

X-grid solved from the written clear sizes: 0 / 8.8333 (kitchen east wall) / 14.0 (main spine) / 18.3333 (bath west) / 23.1667 (bath east = toilet west) / 28. The written 13' rooms (both BEDROOMs, GUEST ROOM, LIVING AREA, VERANDAH) come out 13'-2" clear rather than 13'-0"; the 4" surplus was split evenly either side of the spine so that the bedroom partition, the guest-room east wall and the living/verandah wall all land on ONE line at x=14.0, which is how the sketch draws them (all at the same pixel column, all with a column symbol on that line).

Y-grid solved from the written clear sizes: 0 / 7.5 (living-verandah wall) / 11.8333 (guest room north wall) / 18.3333 (kitchen south = bath south, one continuous line on the sketch) / 22.3333 (toilet south wall) / 27.1667 (wall under both bedrooms) / 40.

VERANDAH is written 13 X 6' but the grid leaves 7'-1" clear between the living/verandah wall and the front building line. The 8" of slack left over from the y-chain (12+8+10+6 clear + five wall thicknesses = 39'-4" against the written 40'-0") was absorbed here, as the verandah is the only depth on the sketch not highlighted/confirmed.

DINING is written 9'2" X 11'6". Its 9'2" width is confirmed by the grid (kitchen east wall to bath west wall). Its 11'6" depth runs past the kitchen/bath wall line and dies in the open stair hall - there is no wall at that station. The DINING box is therefore given as the walled bay only (8'-10" deep) and the written 11'-6" is kept in size_label.

The 4'-0" x 4'-0" space directly below TOI (x 23.1667-28, y 18.3333-22.3333) carries no name on the sketch. It is the lobby giving onto the bath and toilet doors. No room entry was invented for it; its enclosing walls (P-7, P-8, P-9, EX-E) are listed.

The stair hall (x 0-14, y 11.8333-18.3333) also carries no name. Per rule 3 no wall is listed on its east side at x=14 between y=11.8333 and y=18.3333 - the sketch shows nothing there and the stair is entered openly off the LIVING AREA / DINING.

The wall under the bedrooms is dimensioned '3' <-> 3'' either side of the centre column. These are read as the two bedroom doors, each 3'-0" and each hard against the column at x=14 (D1 pos 10.5833 on P-2, D2 pos 0.4167 on P-3).

D4 (BATH): the 2'6" dimension arrow measures 80 px = 2.48 ft, its upper end butting the toilet's south wall. The door is therefore placed hard under that wall - pos 1.0833 from the wall start at y=18.3333.
D6: the sketch's 2'6" gap at the east end of the wall under the bath was placed hard against the east exterior wall inner face (pos 6.75).

D7 and D8 are the two 3'-0" gaps dimensioned on the guest room's east wall - the upper one hard against the guest room's north wall (opening off LIVING AREA), the lower one hard against the front exterior wall (opening off VERANDAH).
D9 (main entrance, the '4'' callout in the living/verandah wall) is not centred - pos 5.25 measured from the wall start at x=14 using the sketch's own scale (30.8 px/ft from the 28' overall).

All window and ventilator positions and widths were MEASURED, not read - the sketch gives no dimension for any of them. Scale used: 30.8 px/ft horizontally and 32.2 px/ft vertically, derived from the written 28' and 40' overall dimensions. Widths were then rounded to the nearest 3".

STAIRCASE - traced, not assumed. Two straight flights drawn one above the other, both with vertical tread lines, so the walk runs in x. 'UP' is lettered at the right with its leader into the LOWER flight, so the ascent starts at the right (up_from 'right'). The left end of the lower band is a blank rectangle with no tread lines - a flat landing on the left (turn_side 'left', winders 0). The upper flight then runs back left-to-right, arrowhead at its right end. This is a U / dog-leg. No well (the flights are drawn adjacent, no X-marked void) and no DN arrow, consistent with a ground floor plan. Approximately 8 treads counted in each flight; the sketch does not number its steps, so start_step is omitted. Flight width is dimensioned 3'-0" (red) beside the upper flight; the 5'-8" clear bay accommodates the two flights.

PORCH is drawn as a stepped semicircular apron projecting in front of the building, beyond the 40' dimension and therefore outside the 28x40 plot. It is given as its bounding box (x 14 to 28, y -6.5 to 0), depth measured at 6'-6"; its true outline is a stepped semicircle. It carries no walls.
The front (south) exterior wall is only listed from x=0 to x=14. The sketch draws the verandah front as a dashed line between two columns - no wall - so the VERANDAH is open to the PORCH.
'Er. Muntasir Alam' is treated as a signature and left out of the title block's project field rather than guessed at as a project name.
